description: Know-Your-Agent (KYA): verify another agent's FractalAI credential (post-quantum signature) and read its live FRC-55 on-chain reputation. Call BEFORE trusting, delegating to, or paying another agent. Returns a post-quantum-signed verdict. Price $0.03 USDC on Base.

check_reputation.description: Default true: re-read live FRC-55 on-chain reputation.

credential.description: A FractalAI KYA credential ({ claim, signature, public_key, credential_id }) to verify.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 X-PAYMENT (EIP-3009 exact-scheme payload, or {txHash}). x402-aware wallet clients pass this automatically via _meta["x402/payment"] — set it explicitly only if your client does not plumb _meta. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge.

name: verify_agent_kya
title: Know-Your-Agent: verify an agent credential
